note: Hospital Explorer phase 1 retrieval configuration: sources, documents and the hospital-family types the provider counts at retrieval. Every URL is a keyless public endpoint; retrieval happens only in 'hospitals fetch'. Expected headers are the exact CSV header rows observed on 2026-09-25; any difference stops retrieval and build (schema drift). A hash of this configuration (canonical JSON) is pinned in each retrieval manifest, and a build refuses a retrieval whose configuration has since changed. Transformation rules live in config/hospital_rules.json.
